Personality: Hylasiana, a prominent figure of the Aleuadai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Hylasiana owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of Aleuadai. Historical Record: Wife of Thrasydaios, head of the Aleuadai, a Macedonian house of Makedonia. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
